material.description: Landed 4d7674e77d87d0fd9d2ac9ff8b6518fb19f85d8c on main (Git API, parent a69d4b3c). CI job data-reload-carry is red. Live run: ev=data_reloaded room=ci tick=1120 units=6 carried=22 dropped=2; match carried units_before=30 units_after=37 positions_kept=21. Cause: carry_units keeps a unit's index only when the new map still holds the same type, owner and position there. Units that moved between load and reload (workers harvest) fail that test, so they are spawned as duplicates while the placed copy stays at its load position. Fixing it needs a Sim position setter and a unit removal, both outside the accessor scope granted (only unit_type and set_hp were added). Owner decision needed: approve Sim::set_position and Sim::remove, or revert the room.rs carry and the ci job.
material.resolution: Does not reproduce on main: carry_live_units matches each index once and removes unmatched units; set_position/remove_unit already in place. No code change.
material.subject: Data swap carry duplicates moved units; needs Sim set_position and remove
material.witness: Live probe on main, cargo test -p server carry_: all live units moved one tile, Room carry path via load_data both sides: before=30 carried=30 refused=0 after=30. No duplicates; row does not reproduce. Both carry tests pass.
